$comment: Release history for three.ws Desktop, newest first. Written by scripts/bump-version.mjs, which collects the data/changelog.json entries tagged `desktop` since the previous release into `notes`. scripts/release-manifest.mjs copies the current version's notes into the published release.json that /desktop and the in-app updater show.

notes.title: three.ws Desktop, the agent console and 3D companion
notes.summary: Sign in, chat with your agents, follow runs and approve what they spend from one app for macOS, Windows and Linux. A 3D companion strolls your desktop and delivers what clears your bar. Local agents run on your machine with keys held in the OS keychain, paper strategies work offline, and every spend shows a native approval with the payload hash before it signs.
